name: com.katout.flowtask.testing.nunit
description: NUnit adapter for FlowTask.Testing: [FailOnUnhandledFlowException] and FlowNUnit.CreateWorld() fail the test on an unhandled flow exception. Reference the FlowTask.Testing.NUnit assembly from a test assembly. List the package in the project's "testables" (Packages/manifest.json), with com.katout.flowtask.testing; otherwise Unity does not compile it (see https://katout.github.io/FlowTask/en/tools/testing/).
